darkStyle: Use case: ui-mockup. Reference image is STYLE ONLY, not content to retain. Create one polished FitMate Android app screen, flat portrait 853x1844, full screen including 9:41 status icons and bottom gesture bar, no phone bezel, no presentation labels, no external annotations. Render all exact Korean text cleanly and within safe margins. Every screen below is a proposal preserving existing functionality.
